name: CelerKit – Gift Cards, Loyalty Points & Subscriptions for WooCommerce
author: CodeVerve

sections.description:
CelerKit gives your WooCommerce store four tools that usually take four plugins: gift cards, loyalty points, subscriptions and everyday store tweaks. Switch on only the modules you need; the ones you leave off stay idle, so your store stays fast. ⚡

🧩 Pick your modules

  • 🎁 Gift Cards: sell gift cards with scheduled delivery, redeemable right at checkout.
  • ⭐ Points & Rewards: reward paid orders with points that customers redeem for a discount.
  • 🔁 Subscriptions: sell recurring products with trials, sign-up fees and automatic renewals.
  • 🛠️ Store Tweaks: sequential order numbers, Buy Now, purchase limits and payment rules.

Every module and tweak starts switched off. Turn on what you want from one menu.

🎁 Gift Cards

  • Sell gift cards as their own WooCommerce product type
  • Cards are issued automatically once the order is paid, each with an encrypted code
  • Pick a delivery date: the card activates that day and lands in the recipient’s inbox 📬
  • Shoppers apply, remove and spend cards right in the Cart and Checkout blocks
  • Recipient details work on the classic product page and with Cart and Checkout blocks
  • Customers see each card’s balance, expiry and activity under My Account
  • They can add a code someone gave them and see funds an unpaid order is holding
  • An append-only ledger tracks every balance change, so spends and refunds add up

⭐ Points & Rewards

  • Customers earn points on paid orders
  • They redeem points for a tax-aware discount in the Cart and Checkout blocks
  • Points used at checkout are held, and returned if the cart empties or time runs out
  • Refunds take points back in proportion, even when the customer has already spent them
  • Every customer gets a full points history on their account page and in the admin
  • Manual adjustments keep an audit trail
  • Points data is included in WordPress personal data exports

🔁 Subscriptions

  • Turn any simple product into a subscription, with an optional one-time purchase choice
  • Free trials, sign-up fees, a fixed number of billing cycles, and billing anchors
  • Renewal orders are created on schedule and charged automatically 💳
  • Card renewals go through the official WooCommerce Stripe Gateway, in any checkout
  • The built-in PayPal gateway handles checkout, free trials, renewals and refunds
  • Other gateways fall back to a renewal order the customer pays from My Account
  • Customers cancel and reactivate from their account, and both of you see the full timeline
  • Lifecycle emails keep customers in the loop

🛠️ Store Tweaks

  • Sequential order numbers: atomic, never duplicated, and searchable with HPOS
  • Buy Now buttons: skip the cart and go straight to checkout
  • Purchase limits: cap quantities per product, variation or cart
  • Payment-method rules: show or hide a gateway by order amount or customer country
  • Conditions: target any tweak by cart, product, location, currency, coupon or role

⚡ Built for modern WooCommerce

  • High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) works whether it is on or off
  • Native Cart and Checkout blocks support, and classic checkout keeps working too
  • Renewals run in the background through Action Scheduler
  • A fast React admin lives in its own CelerKit menu, right below WooCommerce
  • With WooCommerce Subscriptions active, our Subscriptions module steps aside

🔒 Your data stays yours

  • No telemetry and no usage tracking
  • Ledgers live in their own indexed tables in your database
  • Your data survives uninstall unless you delete it under CelerKit → Tools & Status

🎯 Made for stores like

  • A coffee roaster with monthly bean subscriptions and holiday gift cards
  • A fashion boutique rewarding repeat customers with points they spend on their next order
  • A limited-drop shop capping quantities and sending buyers straight to checkout
  • A store that invoices by order number and needs clean sequential numbers for its accountant
  • A store selling abroad that hides cash on delivery outside its home country

💡 Missing a module?

Tell us which tool your store needs next: suggest a module.

🧑‍💻 For developers

  • Override the gift-card and My Account templates from your theme’s celerkit/ folder
  • A versioned REST API covers modules, settings, diagnostics and actions
  • Move the menu under WooCommerce with the celerkit_admin_menu_parent filter
  • Unminified sources ship too: npm ci && npm run build rebuilds them

✅ Requirements

  • WordPress 6.6+ and PHP 8.1+
  • WooCommerce 9.0+
  • Card renewals need the free WooCommerce Stripe Gateway; PayPal needs nothing extra

External services

  • PayPal: when you enable the bundled PayPal gateway, CelerKit sends order totals, currency, order references and saved PayPal payment tokens to the PayPal REST API to take payments, charge renewals, issue refunds and verify webhooks. Terms, privacy.
  • Stripe: card payments run through the separate WooCommerce Stripe Gateway plugin. CelerKit makes no requests to Stripe itself.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce 9.0 or newer.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New Plugin, search for CelerKit, then install and activate it.
  3. Open CelerKit in the admin menu, right below WooCommerce.
  4. On the Modules screen, switch on the modules you want.
  5. Set each one up from its own tab, and you’re ready to sell. 🎉

Selling card subscriptions? Also install the official WooCommerce Stripe Gateway.
sections.faq:
Do I have to use all four modules?

No. Every module starts switched off, and the ones you don’t enable stay idle, so they won’t slow your store down. Turn them on or off at any time without losing data.

Is CelerKit free?

Yes. Everything on this page is included, automatic subscription renewals too.

What do I need to run it?

WordPress 6.6+, PHP 8.1+ and WooCommerce 9.0+. To charge subscription renewals to cards, also install the official WooCommerce Stripe Gateway. The built-in PayPal gateway needs nothing extra.

Can I use it alongside WooCommerce Subscriptions?

Not at the same time. While WooCommerce Subscriptions is active, CelerKit’s Subscriptions module switches itself off, so no renewal is ever charged twice. Your settings and subscriptions are kept, and the module comes back once WooCommerce Subscriptions is deactivated.

How are subscription renewals charged?

CelerKit creates each renewal order on schedule and charges the saved payment method: cards through the WooCommerce Stripe Gateway, PayPal through the built-in gateway. If a gateway can’t charge automatically, the customer gets a renewal order to pay from My Account.

What can my customers do from My Account?

Check gift card balances and add codes they were given, see their points history, and cancel or reactivate their subscriptions.

Can a gift card be delivered on a chosen date?

Yes. Shoppers pick a delivery date from tomorrow onwards. The card stays inactive until that day, then it’s activated and emailed to the recipient. Cancelling or refunding the order before then cancels the delivery.

Does it work with HPOS and the Cart and Checkout blocks?

Yes. CelerKit works with High-Performance Order Storage on or off, and supports the Cart and Checkout blocks as well as classic checkout.

What happens to my data if I uninstall?

Nothing is deleted unless you ask for it. Set data retention to “delete” under CelerKit → Tools & Status first; only then does deleting the plugin remove its tables and settings. Deactivating never removes data.

Does CelerKit track my store?

No. There’s no telemetry or usage tracking. The only outside service it talks to is PayPal, and only after you enable the PayPal gateway.

Where can I get help or suggest a feature?

Ask in the support forum. Have an idea for a new module? Tell us.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • 🎉 First public release with four modules: Gift Cards, Points & Rewards, Subscriptions, and Store Tweaks.
  • Gift cards: dedicated order payment items with refund handling, Cart and Checkout Blocks support, a My Account gift-cards page, scheduled delivery dates, and Store API add-to-cart.
  • Subscriptions: automatic renewals through the WooCommerce Stripe Gateway and the bundled PayPal gateway, dunning, pause/reactivate controls, and refund tracking on the subscription timeline.
  • Rewards: Cart and Checkout Blocks redemption with inline feedback, reservation release when the cart empties, and Store API checkout parity.
  • Admin: a responsive React hub under a top-level CelerKit menu with one submenu item per module; the celerkit_admin_menu_parent filter moves it back under WooCommerce.
  • A versioned REST administration API for modules, declarative settings, diagnostics, paginated resources, operational actions, and rules.

0.5.0-beta.1

  • Replaced the CelerKit admin hub with a responsive React application built from WordPress packages.
  • Added explicit dirty-state saving, search and status filters, confirmation dialogs, and structured rule builders.

0.4.0-beta.1

  • Added the Free-owned Store Tweaks module with order numbering, Buy Now, purchase limits, and conditional gateways.
  • Added atomic order-number sequences, immutable assignments, HPOS search, tracking, and REST lookup.
  • Added the shared StoreRule repository/evaluator and Pro extension contracts.

0.3.0-beta.1

  • Added the Free-owned subscription engine, product plans, trials, sign-up fees, finite cycles, lifecycle controls, emails, REST endpoints, privacy integration, and renewal scheduling.
  • Added automatic Stripe renewals through the official gateway, including Checkout Blocks off-session payment-method capture.
  • Added PayPal Orders v2 and Vault v3 checkout, zero-cost trial setup, renewals, refunds, token deletion handling, and verified idempotent webhooks.
  • Added stable module, extension, settings, view, action, and admin APIs for premium enhancements.

0.2.0-alpha.1

  • Rebuilt Points & Rewards around an atomic, idempotent FIFO ledger.
  • Added checkout reservations, proportional refund handling, REST/Store API data, Blocks UI, schedulers, reconciliation, and privacy integration.
  • Added RewardHive conflict detection and a development-data migration from the early points prototype.

0.1.0

  • Initial development prototype.
